test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All peacocks are lion.

Some lions are dogs.

No dog is a cat.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some lions are not cats.

II. Some peacocks are dogs.

III. Some peacocks are not lion.

options.text: Conclusions I, II and III follow
Only conclusion II and III follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1cdb115292b74293e6e99a6af802c8dd6afc6319f6d305fd79c3a4e862b8838.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some lions are not cats → Follow (As some lions are dogs and no dog is a cat. As some part of lions is common with dogs which cannot be cat, therefore it is true.)

II. Some peacocks are dogs → Does not follow (As all peacocks are lion and some lions are dogs. So it is possible but not definite.)

III. Some peacocks are not lion → Does not follow (As all peacocks are lion. As whole peacocks comes in lion, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
